corpus.notes: Corpus is heavily saturated on P1: a mid/late-July automated wave (#170-#211) already covered code through v0.0.19 (current HEAD 81255fa) — selector matching, display-list O(N^2), flex/grid exponential, scroll clone churn (#207), glyph-cull h=0 (#204), HintingInstance growth (#205), net transport reuse (#210), per-worker DNS (#184), cookie growth (#176/#181/#182), SVG stores (#194), event-dispatch serialize (#195), UI-thread decode (#211), console growth (#206). This run therefore audited the seams those issues did NOT touch: present/composite copy loops, the mirror render path, the JS drain scheduler contract, net retry semantics, and storage persistence granularity. #68/#69/#70/#71 from the 2026-07-01 run are all closed (fixed).

findings.title: UI-thread JS budget incomplete: page-install drain runs with EventLoopBudget::default() (no wall cap) as one poll() job; all interactive call sites discard EventLoopStats so hit_wall_cap yields are never re-pumped and pending timers stall
Present path does per-pixel copy loops twice per frame: blit_scaled divides twice per pixel even in its documented 1:1 case; Framebuffer::blit copies 4 bytes at a time with per-pixel bounds checks
MirrorShell re-runs full style cascade + layout + raster on every redraw of every window (and a second cascade per click) — the v0.0.15 layout cache never reached the mirror path
UA-ladder soft-block retry re-sends non-idempotent requests (POST body replayed on 403/429/503, up to 2 extra transmissions) with no backoff on 429
Storage::save single global dirty flag rewrites + fsyncs every partition's cookies.bin on any single cookie change, synchronously on the UI thread

duplicates_skipped: Glyph vspan cull + content_height read GlyphBox.h which is always 0 — already #204
HintingInstance per-(face,px) cache unbounded — already #205 (glyph coverage cache itself is bounded at 4 MiB)
render_frame per-frame display-list clones / scaled(1.0) clone / content_height rescan / two framebuffer allocations — already #207
Per-frame collect_computed + set_computed_styles push into JS on scripted pages — already #22 (still-live half of that issue)
reconcile_realm full DOM serialize per settled fetch — covered by #195's root cause and body
Paint primitives iterating full author rect without clip pre-intersection — already #196
Sync image decode inside poll() — already #211
Fresh TCP+TLS per request / DoH handshakes — already #210; per-worker DNS caches — already #184
Cookie store growth/insert O(m^2) (#176), per-candidate format! (#181), partitions or_default growth (#182) — all filed
Inline-SVG payload stores never cleared — already #194; console history growth + per-frame re-serialization — already #206
no_findings_areas: cerberus-image: decode is properly bounded (header-dim precheck, SVG byte ceiling, longest-side cap); app image store cleared on navigation
cerberus-net dns.rs CachingResolver: bounded, TTL'd, sane eviction (the remaining gap is #184's per-worker duplication)
cerberus-js-quickjs: #68 limits (heap/stack/interrupt watchdog) confirmed in place with tests
cerberus-dom parser: rawtext O(n^2) fix (#23) confirmed; no new hot-path issue found
cerberus-layout v0.0.17 negative-z split and v0.0.18 table-nesting cap: implementations check out; no new finding beyond the filed #170/#175/#183/#187 set
overall_health: Good; velocity is high (v0.0.14-v0.0.19 since last state) and the prior review wave (#170-#211) already pinned most hot-path perf debt with current-HEAD accuracy, so this pass found its value at the seams: the JS drain scheduler's unfinished yield/resume contract (#213, the one high), two O(surface) per-frame copy loops under the newly-optimized rasterizer (#214), the mirror path missing the v0.0.15 cache (#215), a non-idempotent network retry (#216), and coarse persistence dirty-tracking (#217). Top open priorities remain #210 (transport reuse), #170 (exponential nested flex/grid), #195 (per-event DOM serialize), #151/#177 (CSS recursion stack overflows), and now #213.
